dedupe_keys.name: prasa autoridad de acueductos y alcantarillados daily reservoir levels puerto rico

description: The Puerto Rico Aqueduct and Sewer Authority (PRASA) publishes the levels of the reservoirs it uses for water supply on a page of its website, with a chart of levels. All values are given in metres above sea level, and the difference is computed against the 5:00 AM reading of the previous day. The reservoirs listed on 27 September 2026 were Carraízo, La Plata, Cidra, Patillas, Toa Vaca, Carite, Río Blanco, Caonillas, Fajardo, Guajataca and Cerrillos. Coverage is the main supply reservoirs of Puerto Rico. Access is online and free on the PRASA website. Caveats: the values load after a delay in the browser, the page gives current levels and a chart, not a download, and no licence is stated. Simulation uses: reservoir state for drought, rationing and hurricane recovery scenarios in water supply models of Puerto Rico. Related records: Jamaica reservoir levels (data-nwc-jamaica-reservoir-levels) and Taiwan reservoir conditions (data-taiwan-wra-reservoir-conditions-and-water-open-data).
